items.subject: Grocery: semantic sweep found 1 product(s) no rule can see - 2026-09-19
evidence: grocery/out/semantic-findings.json (generated 2026-09-19 08:30 over comparison-2026-09-17: board_pairs 3188, corpus 41841, rule_invisible 7991): coverage 1 = pie-pumpkins | Family Fare | 'Jj's Bakery Pie, Pumpkin Spice, Ligthly Glazed 4 Oz' | cos 0.682 | score 0.908; a 4 oz glazed snack pie, not a pumpkin. coverage_excluded 2 (Similac RTF on baby-formula, 80/20 patties) already suppressed by the 09-18 fix

explain-coverage-gap classification of the finding, reproduced by hand against commodities.json index 518: pie-pumpkins admit patterns [pie\s+pumpkins?, sugar\s+pumpkins?, baking\s+pumpkins?] - the comma in 'Pie, Pumpkin' defeats \s+, so none matches (NO-INCLUDE verdict); yet pie-pumpkins' own exclude 'spice' MATCHES the name. coverage-explain-lib.ps1:53-55 tests excludes only after an admit hit, so a product the commodity's rule would refuse on sight is paged as 'a product no rule can see'

what else the same mechanism lets through, measured: the five NO-INCLUDE names ruled on 2026-09-18 (Jimmy Dean Biscuit Roll Ups x2 on breakfast-sandwiches, 73/27 ground beef on ground-beef-93-7, swai on tilapia, leg quarters on chicken-breast) hit NO exclude of their commodity, so the exclude-hit verdict would have suppressed 1 of the 6 NO-INCLUDE findings of the last two days (today's) and none of yesterday's

RETURN mechanics: the type fired on 18 of the last 29 days (alert-census.jsonl); the 09-18 close (37ac63) taught the emitter to suppress EXCLUDED findings and made add-known-wrong refuse the comma-join name shape; its own leaves_open said 'the sweep pages each such SKU on its first sighting, which is the intended intake'. The alert body itself says a coverage finding 'can never win a cell - not this week and not any future week', so no price is at risk on the day it pages, yet it pages through the DAILY lane

the finding is not a board defect (no cell holds it) and needs no ruling: a ruling is keyed to a name reaching the commodity, and this name cannot reach pie-pumpkins without a rule change nobody wants

surface_fix.what: no ruling and no rule change; the emitter classifies the finding as refused
surface_fix.exact_change: Get-CoverageVerdict: when no admit pattern matched but at least one of $WantId's excludes matches the name, return verdict 'REFUSED-BY-EXCLUDE' with detail "no admit pattern matches, and exclude '<pattern>' would refuse it anyway"; Split-CoverageFindings treats REFUSED-BY-EXCLUDE like EXCLUDED (kept under coverage_excluded, out of the alerted set)

items.root_cause: the sweep is a similarity detector over 7,991 rule-invisible products and it pages every lookalike once through the daily lane, although its own text says no such product can move a cell until a person changes a rule; the intake for a lookalike is a hand ruling or a rule change one product at a time, so the type returns on most days by design (18 of 29). Within that, the classifier only consults a commodity's excludes after an admit-pattern hit, so a product the rule would refuse on sight still pages

root_fix.what: page the coverage class at the cadence of its harm: weekly, batched, with the refused ones already stripped
root_fix.exact_change: the coverage-findings alert in check-ad-cycles.ps1 is sent with -Lane weekly (send-alert.ps1 already mints weekly-lane items; triage-due.ps1 lists them for pull-forward only), while IDENTITY findings (a wrong product holding a live cell) stay daily; audit-semantic-identity.ps1 writes the day's findings to out\semantic-findings-<date>.json as well as the latest file so the weekly item carries every day's findings, and a (commodity|store|normalised product) already present in an earlier dated file inside 30 days is counted as 'seen' and not re-paged

items.leaves_open: a NO-INCLUDE lookalike that hits no exclude (5 of the 6 recent findings) still needs a person, now once a week instead of daily; that is the intended intake and the residual is the cadence, not a defect

prevention.what: the emitter stops paging what a rule would refuse on sight, and pages what is left at the weekly cadence its own text says the harm has

blast_radius.measured_by: the 8 coverage findings the emitter produced on 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-19 (7 + 1), each classified against commodities.json at fe2ad786e; the sweep's 7,991-name rule-invisible corpus is not persisted, so the suppression rate over it is unmeasured and this plan says so
names: Jj's Bakery Pie, Pumpkin Spice, Ligthly Glazed 4 Oz
blast_radius.risk: an exclude-hit suppression can hide a real coverage gap only when a commodity's exclude is overbroad for a product its admit patterns cannot see; explain-coverage-gap still lists every suppressed row under coverage_excluded, so the weekly item can read them. No routing changes: no commodity rule is edited and no cell moves

items.freshness: measured against semantic-findings.json of 2026-09-19 08:30 (over comparison-2026-09-17 built 08:12) and known-wrong.json at fe2ad786e

proof.guard_or_fixture: audit-semantic-identity.ps1 -SelfTest (the Split-CoverageFindings cases at lines 205-215) + test-auditors.ps1 (the watcher must still fire on its founding fixture) + check-ad-cycles.ps1 -SelfTest for the lane
proof.must_fire_case: frozen row 'Jj's Bakery Pie, Pumpkin Spice, Ligthly Glazed 4 Oz' / pie-pumpkins is classified REFUSED-BY-EXCLUDE and lands in coverage_excluded, not in the alerted set; a coverage alert mints a weekly-lane item; a finding present in yesterday's dated file is not paged again
proof.clean_twin: 'Ground Beef 73% Lean/27% Fat, All Natural*, 4 lb Tray' / ground-beef-93-7 stays NO-INCLUDE and stays in the alerted set; the existing EXCLUDED cases (patties, swai) still classify EXCLUDED; an IDENTITY finding still pages through the daily lane

items.rollback: revert the three files; the dated findings files are additive
items.resolution_note: A 4 oz pumpkin-spice snack pie read as a pie pumpkin. No rule can see it and none should; pie-pumpkins' own exclude 'spice' would refuse it, but the classifier only asks excludes after an admit hit, so it paged as invisible. The classifier now reports REFUSED-BY-EXCLUDE and suppresses it, and coverage findings (which by the alert's own words can move no cell) now mint weekly-lane items with same-product de-duplication, while identity findings stay daily. No ruling filed: a ruling for a name that cannot reach the commodity is inert.

prior close 2026-09-18-35e0f5 (plan-2026-09-18.json, done, claude-store 1fd6f85): persisted failing steps' tails and put the path recognition floor to Brad (Q3); today's three failures are different steps

surface_fix.what: rebuild both indexes; classify the eight fires; park the cluster ruling
surface_fix.exact_change: run recall-reindex.py once and re-run check-skills.py (expect equal index counts and the gate green); for the reflex, read the 8 in-window fires' commands by chash from the transcripts (recall-reflex-stats.py or the session logs) and classify each as a real publish/build-cards START or a read (grep, Get-Content, Select-String, -DryRun, -WhatIf, a path quoted in a commit message): if 3 or more are reads, extend the negative lookahead to (?![^\n]*(?:-SelfTest|-DryRun|-WhatIf)) and add a must_not_fire per read shape found; otherwise raise max_fire_rate to 0.03 and write in rung_why that 8 of 8 in-window fires were real starts on <date>

items.root_cause: the nightly pass treats a failure it has fully diagnosed and can repair (the corpus moved since the last joint rebuild) the same as one that needs a person, so a mechanical re-index pages as RED and stays red until somebody types the command it printed; the reflex log records a fire by hash only, so a TOO LOUD verdict cannot be adjudicated from the log it came from; and the cluster marks are one-way ratchets whose only release is a human ruling, which is correct and means that step is a question, not a defect

root_fix.what: the pass repairs what it can prove is mechanical before it grades
root_fix.exact_change: recall-sleep.py: before the 'gate' step, a 'reindex if moved' step compares the joint-rebuild stamp with the current tree hash the gate computes (lift that comparison into a function check-skills.py exports) and runs recall-reindex.py when they differ, recording 'reindexed: <old stamp> -> <new stamp>' in the run record; the gate then pages only if the counts still disagree. recall-reflex-hook.py: the reflex log line gains the first 120 characters of the command that fired (through the existing redactor if one exists, otherwise only the tool and the matched substring), so a fire-rate verdict can be adjudicated from the log

items.leaves_open: the memory-clusters step stays red until Brad rules the 1 same-store cluster and 1 of the 10 cross-project clusters (or accepts a mark move with its reason); the approvals inbox item inbox-cluster_x-3b677e9f2cd5-e8398558 is where that ruling lands, listed under open_questions_for_brad as q-2026-09-19-clusters

Gate: the two indexes hold different corpora (2206 vs 1988) because the corpus moved since the last joint rebuild; the pass named its own remedy and now runs it before grading. open_questions_for_brad.question: The knowledge store's memory-clusters step is red: 1 unruled same-store cluster over a mark of 0 and 10 unruled cross-project clusters over a mark of 9 (recall-consolidate.py). The marks may only go down, so only a ruling clears it. Options: (A) rule the two clusters that breach (write a gist each; the approvals inbox already holds inbox-cluster_x-3b677e9f2cd5-e8398558 for one of them); (B) accept a one-time mark move 9 -> 10 with the reason written in recall-consolidate.py, which the mark's own text discourages; (C) leave it red and let the nightly pass keep saying so. Recommendation: A.

The board verifier scores an online multipack as wrong-size (Walmart '(12 pack) Great Value Original Baked Beans, 28 oz' at 0.0657/oz; 08-15 scored three Walmart bundles the same way) while the board flags such rows bulk and keeps them. Which rule is the board's? (A) bulk rows stay and the verifier stops scoring them as defects (change the SKILL rule); (B) a multipack not sold as such in store is not the store's shelf price and the engine should refuse online-only bundles at Walmart (a matching/basis change, money lane, separate plan); (C) leave both as they are and accept the disagreement in every future rate. Recommendation: decide A or B; C makes the rate unreadable.
